items.title: Simplify compliance with the native pre-written policy experience in HCP Terraform
items.blurb: Teams can now browse HashiCorp-managed pre-written policies, add them to a policy set, and apply common compliance guardrails directly in HCP Terraform.

items.title: SolidStart 2: Replaces Vinxi with a Vite 8 and Enters Maintenance as Its Role Winds Down
items.blurb: SolidStart, a full-stack meta-framework based on SolidJS, has transitioned to version 2.0, improving compatibility with Vite's Environment API.

items.title: MariaDB 13 Expands Oracle Compatibility and Improves Developer Experience and Observability
items.blurb: MariaDB Community Server 13.0 has reached General Availability (GA) and is now officially stable.

items.title: The Implications of Linguistic Illegibility for LLM Security
items.blurb: LLMs are trained to generate natural language. However, various strands of evidence indicate that an LLM's externalized linguistic outputs and mechanistically-extracted linguistic features can be an unreliable lens for understanding…
